title: Customize your workspace
subtitle: Adjust theme, accent colors, queue behavior, notification preferences, and more — all in one place.

hero.title: A complete control center for every visual mode
hero.description: Each mode keeps the same local settings inventory intact while changing how the shell feels, reads, and moves across the product.

glass.label: Glass panels
glass.desc: Enable translucent cards in the main application shell.

visual_mode_descriptions.dashboard: Operational, dense, and explicit. Best when you want the full control grid at once.
visual_mode_descriptions.editorial: Narrative, spacious, and typographic. Keeps all controls but changes the reading rhythm.
visual_mode_descriptions.cinematic: Immersive, contrast-heavy, and atmospheric. Retains every local control inside a dramatic shell.

cancel.label: Cancel previous
cancel.desc: Cancel older requests when a new one starts.

sound.label: Sound
sound.desc: Play a tone when the system returns a result.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Theme, accent, motion, density, glass surfaces, and interface language.

mode.title: Mode orchestration
mode.description: Control visual mode, shell preset, and component treatment without touching backend settings.

queue.title: Queue and archive
queue.description: Tune local queue behavior, cancellation policy, and visible archive depth.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose whether the interface announces finished generations with desktop alerts and sound.

safety.title: Safety and prompt defaults
safety.description: Keep NSFW visibility and negative guidance defaults explicit at the shell level.

presets.title: Default presets
presets.description: Manage reusable local preset bundles for generation defaults.

presets.neg_placeholder: Default negative prompt for this preset
